Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The system event message type is used to signal a market or data feed handler event.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: Refer to System Event Codes below.

Message.Name: Stock Directory Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, NASDAQ disseminates stock directory messages for all active symbols in Single Book.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the NASDAQ Single Book.

Field.Name: Market Category
Field.Description: Indicates Listing market or listing market tier for the issue.

Field.Name: Financial Status Indicator
Field.Description: Indicates when a firm is not in compliance with NASDAQ continued listing requirements.

Field.Name: Round Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the number of shares that represent a round lot for the issue.

Field.Name: Round Lots Only
Field.Description: Indicates if NASDAQ system limits order entry for issue.

Message.Name: Stock Trading Action Message
Message.Description: NASDAQ uses this administrative message to indicate the current trading status of a security to the trading community.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Current Trading State
Field.Description: Indicates the current trading state for the stock.

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: Trading Action reason.

Message.Name: Reg SHO Restriction Message
Message.Description: Denotes the Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction status for the issue at the time of the message dissemination.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Reg SHO Action
Field.Description: Denotes the Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction status for the issue.

Message.Name: Noii Message
Message.Description: NASDAQ disseminates NOII data at 5-second intervals in the minutes leading up to the NASDAQ Opening and Closing Crosses as well as the IPO/Halt Crosses.

Field.Name: Paired Shares
Field.Description: Indicates the total number of shares that are eligible to be matched at the Current Reference Price.

Field.Name: Imbalance Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares not paired at the Current Reference Price.

Field.Name: Imbalance Direction
Field.Description: Indicates the market side of the imbalance.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for which the NOII message is being generated.

Field.Name: Far Price
Field.Description: A hypothetical auction-clearing price for cross orders only.

Field.Name: Near Price
Field.Description: A hypothetical auction-clearing price for cross orders as well as continuous orders.

Field.Name: Current Reference Price
Field.Description: Indicates price at which the NOII shares are being calculated.

Field.Name: Cross Type
Field.Description: Denotes the type of NASDAQ cross for which the NOII message is being generated.

Field.Name: Price Variation Indicator
Field.Description: This field indicates the absolute value of the percentage of deviation of the Near Indicative Clearing Price to the nearest Current Reference Price.

Message.Name: Cross Trade Message
Message.Description: Cross Trade message indicates that NASDAQ has completed its cross process for a specific security.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares matched in the NASDAQ Cross.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: The security symbol associated with the cross trade message.

Field.Name: Cross Price
Field.Description: The price at which the cross occurred.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: The NASDAQ generated day-unique Match Number of this execution.

Field.Name: Cross Type
Field.Description: The NASDAQ cross session for which the message is being generated.

Value.Name: Start of Messages
Value.Description: This is always the first message sent in any trading day.

Value.Name: Start of System Hours
Value.Description: This message indicates that NASDAQ is open and ready to start accepting orders.

Value.Name: Start of Market Hours
Value.Description: This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours orders are available for execution.

Value.Name: Clear NOII - Opening Cross Data
Value.Description: This message signals that firms may clear NOII cache for the regular Opening Cross.

Value.Name: End of Market Hours
Value.Description: This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours orders are no longer available for execution.

Value.Name: End of System Hours
Value.Description: It indicates that NASDAQ is now closed and will not accept any new orders.

Value.Name: End of Messages
Value.Description: This is always the last message sent in any trading day.

Value.Name: Company is in compliance
Value.Description: Company is in compliance, if NASDAQ-listed issue.
